source.notes: arch-006 (A2 indexed-K1). MoBA: sequence split into chunks (last chunk excluded for causality); gate score = q·mean_pool(k_block); top-(topk-1) blocks per (head, token) with the current block always chunk-local; selected-block tokens gathered and attended. The block-gating route is external; the mixer is the shared typed indexed-K1 call (architectures/indexed_attention.py). The chunk-local self-attention merge and the full MoBA layer are residual. Layer module: architectures/moba.py.

params.axis: A2 indexed-K1: top-k block route + gather-attend

coverage.notes: Gather-attend parity vs the equation oracle, the route-causality invariant (no future token selected) in tests/test_architectures_a2_indexed.py. The chunk-local merge and the full layer are residual, not claimed.
